Apply an appropriate amount to the affected area 1 to 4 times a day.
entries.1제 4 L와 2제 90 mL를 혼합합니다.이 약은 다음과 같은 순서대로: Mix 4 L of agent 1 with 90 mL of agent 2. Use this medicine in the following order. First, immerse the pre-cleaned medical instruments completely in the prepared disinfectant solution. For instruments and machinery with fine pores or a complex structure, use pressure injection or suction so that they are thoroughly wetted with the prepared disinfectant solution. Perform a leak test first if necessary. Immerse completely for at least 5 minutes. If sporicidal action is required, immerse completely for at least 10 minutes. After thorough immersion, remove the items and rinse them under running sterile purified water for at least 15 seconds. Depending on the purpose of use, a large volume of water may be used; for instruments with fine pores or a complex structure the disinfectant solution tends to remain inside, so rinse thoroughly by pressure-injecting sterile purified water or water, or by extending the rinsing time. After disinfection of the medical instruments is complete and before the instruments are used, always check for residues of this medicine using a hydrogen peroxide residue test strip or similar and confirm that the level is below 0.5 ppm as hydrogen peroxide.
Apply an appropriate amount per application several times a day.
entries.30개월 이하의 유아는 이 약을 사용하지 마십시오.이 약을 사용하기 전에: Do not use this medicine in infants aged 30 months or younger. Before using this medicine, consult a doctor or pharmacist if you have experienced hypersensitivity to medicines or cosmetics (rash, redness (congested and reddened skin), itching, dermatitis caused by lacquer and the like), if you have an allergic constitution, if you have severe moist (damp) or eroded (macerated) skin, or if the user is a child. Follow the specified dosage and administration exactly. When giving it to a child, administer it under the guidance and supervision of a guardian. Use this medicine externally only and do not take it internally. Take care to keep it out of the eyes, and if it does get into the eyes, rinse them immediately with water. If symptoms do not improve after 5 to 6 days of use, stop using it and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.광감작, 드물게 쇽 증상(구역, 불쾌감, 식은땀, 어지러움, 답답함, 호: If photosensitisation, rarely shock symptoms (nausea, malaise, cold sweat, dizziness, chest tightness, difficulty breathing, redness), or occasionally hypersensitivity symptoms such as rash or hives occur, stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.국소 알레르기, 접촉성 습진, 전신 알레르기, 쇽 증상(구역, 불쾌감,: If local allergy, contact eczema, systemic allergy, shock symptoms (nausea, malaise, cold sweat, dizziness, chest tightness, difficulty breathing, redness), photosensitisation or the like occur, stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.다른 소독제와 혼합하여 사용하지 마십시오.외용으로만 사용하십시오.비누류는: Do not mix this medicine with other disinfectants. Use it externally only. Soaps weaken the bactericidal action of this medicine, so wash them off thoroughly before use. Take care to keep the undiluted or concentrated solution out of the eyes, and if it does get in, rinse the eyes thoroughly with water. When a concentrated solution is used, irritation of the skin and mucous membranes may occur, so use it with care. If iron instruments have to be immersed for a long time, dissolve sodium nitrite in the solution to prevent corrosion, except for copper items. (This does not affect the bactericidal action.)
entries.드물게 쇽 (예: 구역, 불쾌감, 식은땀, 어지러움, 답답함, 호흡곤란,: If shock occurs rarely (for example nausea, malaise, cold sweat, dizziness, chest tightness, difficulty breathing, redness), or if hypersensitivity such as rash or hives occurs occasionally, stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. Photosensitisation may occur.
entries.드물게 쇽 증상(구역, 불쾌감, 식은땀, 어지러움, 답답함, 호흡곤란,: If shock symptoms occur rarely (nausea, malaise, cold sweat, dizziness, chest tightness, difficulty breathing, redness), or if hypersensitivity symptoms (occasionally rash or hives) or photosensitisation occur, stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.드물게 쇽(구역, 불쾌감, 식은땀, 어지러움, 답답함, 호흡곤란, 발적): If shock occurs rarely (nausea, malaise, cold sweat, dizziness, chest tightness, difficulty breathing, redness), if hypersensitivity such as rash or hives occurs occasionally, or if anaphylactic shock of unknown frequency occurs, stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. Photosensitisation may occur.
entries.드물게 쇽, 구역, 불쾌감, 식은땀, 어지러움, 답답함, 호흡곤란, 발적: If shock, nausea, malaise, cold sweat, dizziness, chest tightness, difficulty breathing or redness (congested and reddened skin) occurs rarely, or if hypersensitivity symptoms such as rash or hives occur occasionally, stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. Photosensitisation may occur.
entries.때때로 발진, 가려움 등이 나타나는 경우 사용을 즉각 중지하고 의사 또는: If rash or itching occurs occasionally, stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.면봉이나 깨끗한 손으로 소량을 덜어 통증 부위에 바릅니다.20분 이상 기: Take a small amount with a cotton swab or a clean hand and apply it to the painful area. If the pain continues after waiting 20 minutes or more, this medicine may be applied again, after which further applications should be at least 3 hours apart.
entries.발진, 발적, 가려움, 부기 등이 나타나는 경우 사용을 즉각 중지하고 의: If rash, redness, itching or swelling occurs, stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
Apply it to the area to be disinfected.
entries.쇽(예: 구역, 식은땀, 어지러움, 답답함, 호흡곤란, 발적), 때때로: If shock (for example nausea, cold sweat, dizziness, chest tightness, difficulty breathing, redness) occurs, or if hypersensitivity such as rash or hives occurs occasionally, stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.약액이 흡수된 스폰지를 손과 팔꿈치까지 적용하여 5분간 손으로 문지릅니다: Apply the sponge soaked with the solution to the hands and up to the elbows and rub by hand for 5 minutes. Use a brush if necessary, rubbing the nails, the cuticles and the areas between the fingers with particular care. Then rinse with warm water, repeat the procedure washing for 3 minutes, rinse thoroughly with water and dry slowly.
entries.용도에 따라 다음의 농도로 희석하여 사용하십시오.손 및 피부의 소독(보건: Dilute to the following concentrations according to the intended use. For disinfection of the hands and skin (excluding hand disinfection of health and hygiene workers and of the operator during surgery, and disinfection of the skin at the surgical site) use a 0.1 - 0.5% aqueous solution; for disinfection of medical devices use a 0.1 - 0.5% aqueous solution or a 0.5% ethanol solution; for disinfection of furniture and instruments and for disinfection of wounded areas of the skin use a 0.05% aqueous solution.
entries.이 약 1매를 젖은 손에 30초간 잘 문지른 후 물로 깨끗이 세척하고 완: Rub 1 sheet of this medicine thoroughly over wet hands for 30 seconds, then rinse the hands thoroughly with water and dry them completely; discard the sheet after a single use.
entries.이 약 사용 후 땀분비의 감소가 일시적으로 자극감이나 충혈되어 붉어지는: After using this medicine, the reduction in sweating may temporarily cause a feeling of irritation or redness with congestion of the skin. If these symptoms become severe, suspend use of this medicine. If irritation or hypersensitivity reactions including dermatitis occur at the application site, stop using this medicine immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. If application site reactions such as pain, itching, erythema, rash or a burning sensation of the skin occur rarely, stop using this medicine immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.이 약에 과민증 경험자, 뇌, 척수, 귀, 질, 방광, 구강 등의 점막면: Do not use this medicine if you have experienced hypersensitivity to it, and do not use it on the brain, spinal cord, ear, vagina, bladder, oral cavity or other mucosal surfaces, on the eyes, or on eroded (macerated) or suppurating areas. Before using this medicine, consult a doctor or pharmacist if you are a patient with hypersensitivity to other medicines, with an allergic disease such as asthma or a history or family history of one, if you are pregnant or may be pregnant, or if you are breastfeeding. Follow the specified dosage and administration exactly. Use this medicine externally only; do not take it orally and do not inject it. Contact with the eyes may cause corneal damage, so take care to keep it out of the eyes, and if it does get in, rinse them thoroughly with clean water immediately. This medicine is adsorbed onto textiles and cloth (cotton, gauze, wool, rayon and the like), so when it is used by soaking such material, supply fresh solution whenever the effective concentration is no longer maintained. Replace the diluted solution used for washing the hands with fresh solution at least once a day.
entries.이 약에 과민증 경험자는 사용하지 마십시오.다른 약물에 과민증 환자, 천: Do not use this medicine if you have experienced hypersensitivity to it. Consult a doctor or pharmacist if you are a patient with hypersensitivity to other medicines, a patient with an allergic disease such as asthma or a history or family history of one, a woman who is pregnant or may be pregnant, or a breastfeeding woman. Use this medicine externally only; do not take it orally and do not inject it. Contact with the eyes may cause corneal damage, so take care to keep it out of the eyes, and if it does get in, rinse them thoroughly with clean water immediately. This medicine is adsorbed onto textiles and cloth (cotton, gauze, wool, rayon and the like), so when it is used by soaking such material, supply fresh solution whenever the effective concentration is no longer maintained. Anions contained in saline and similar solutions form poorly soluble salts, so use clean distilled water when diluting it. Replace the diluted solution used for washing the hands and similar purposes with fresh solution at least once a day.
entries.이 약에 과민증 환자, 12세 미만 소아는 의사 또는 약사와 상의하십시오: Patients with hypersensitivity to this medicine and children under 12 years of age should consult a doctor or pharmacist.
Do not use this medicine in patients with hypersensitivity to it or in infants aged 2 months or younger. Do not use it for disinfecting surgical instruments or on the brain, spinal cord, eyes, ears (inner, middle or outer ear) or mucous membranes (especially genital mucosa). Before using this medicine, consult a doctor or pharmacist if you have an allergic constitution, broken skin (especially burns) or large areas of immature skin, or if you have or have had hypersensitivity to Yellow No. 5. Use it externally only; do not take it orally and do not inject it. Take care to keep it out of the eyes, and if it does get in, rinse them thoroughly with clean water immediately. Soaps weaken the bactericidal action of this medicine, so wash them off thoroughly before use. This medicine is adsorbed onto textiles and cloth (cotton, gauze, wool, rayon and the like), so when it is used by soaking such material, supply fresh solution whenever the effective concentration is no longer maintained. It is a flammable liquid, so handle it with care. Dry the treated area before using electrical equipment.
entries.이 약에 과민증 환자, 2세 이하의 소아, 갑상선 기능 이상(특히 결절성: Do not use this medicine in patients with hypersensitivity to it, in children aged 2 years or younger, or in patients with thyroid dysfunction (especially nodular goitre, endemic goitre, Hashimoto's thyroiditis and the like), renal failure or dermatitis herpetiformis, or in patients undergoing radioactive iodine therapy or in the period before and after such therapy. Before using this medicine, consult a doctor or pharmacist if you are a seriously ill patient (such as a burn patient), if you have thyroid disease or a history of renal failure, or if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. Do not use it ophthalmically or internally. Take care to keep it out of the eyes, and if it does get into the eyes, rinse them immediately with clean water. Do not mix it with other preparations. Wash and disinfect the affected area thoroughly. Soaps weaken the bactericidal action of this medicine, so wash them off thoroughly before use.
entries.이 약에 과민증 환자, 뇌, 척수, 귀, 질, 방광, 구강 등의 점막면,: Do not administer this medicine to patients with hypersensitivity to it, or to the brain, spinal cord, ear, vagina, bladder, oral cavity or other mucosal surfaces, or to the eyes. Consult a doctor or pharmacist if you are a patient with hypersensitivity to other medicines, if you have experienced an allergic reaction such as asthma, if it is to be applied around the vulva immediately before delivery, or if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. Ophthalmic devices with glass or metal joints are corroded by this medicine, so do not use it on them. Use this medicine externally only. Contact with the eyes may cause corneal damage, so take care to keep it out of the eyes, and if it does get in, rinse them thoroughly with clean water immediately. This medicine is adsorbed onto textiles and cloth (cotton, gauze, wool, rayon and the like), so when it is used by soaking such material, supply fresh solution whenever the effective concentration is no longer maintained. Anions contained in saline and similar solutions form poorly soluble salts, so use clean distilled water when diluting it. Replace the diluted solution used for washing the hands and similar purposes with fresh solution at least once a day.
entries.이 약에 과민증 환자는 이 약을 사용하지 마십시오.귀 또는 점막, 눈 주: Do not use this medicine in patients with hypersensitivity to it. Do not use it on the ears, on mucous membranes or around the eyes. Before using this medicine, pregnant or breastfeeding women and newborn infants should consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.이 약에 과민증 환자는 이 약을 사용하지 마십시오.이 약은 12시간 이내: Do not use this medicine in patients with hypersensitivity to it. Do not use this medicine on skin shaved within the previous 12 hours, on damaged or irritated skin, or on the eyes, nostrils, mouth or other mucous membranes; if it accidentally contacts the eyes or other mucous membranes, wash it off thoroughly with water. Depilatories must not be used on the affected area within 12 hours before or after using this medicine. Before using this medicine, pregnant women, breastfeeding women and children aged 12 years or younger should consult a doctor or pharmacist before use. This medicine reacts with water to produce hydrochloric acid, so dry the treatment area completely before using it in order to avoid a burning sensation of the skin. Use it only on the area to be treated. After using this medicine, the reduction in sweating may temporarily cause a feeling of irritation or redness (congested and reddened skin); if these symptoms become severe, suspend use.
This medicine is used for hyperhidrosis (excessive sweating) of the armpits, hands and feet.
entries.이 약은 궤양, 화상, 베인 상처, 긁힌 상처 및 기타 가벼운 상처의 살: This medicine is used for the bactericidal disinfection of ulcers, burns, cuts, scratches and other minor wounds.
This medicine is used for hand disinfection by health and hygiene workers.
entries.이 약은 손 및 피부의 소독, 수술부위의 피부소독, 수술부위의 점막소독,: This medicine is used for disinfection of the hands and skin, disinfection of the skin at the surgical site, disinfection of the mucous membranes at the surgical site, disinfection of wounded areas of the skin and mucous membranes, disinfection of medical devices, and disinfection of operating room and ward furniture, instruments and articles.
This medicine is used for the bactericidal disinfection of the operator's hands and arms.
entries.이 약은 외용으로만 사용하십시오.눈에 들어가지 않도록 주의하십시오.깊은,: Use this medicine externally only. Take care to keep it out of the eyes. Do not use it on deep, puncture or lacerated wounds or on infected areas. Wash the affected area thoroughly before applying it.
This medicine is used for the disinfection and sterilisation of medical materials and similar items.
entries.이 약은 치은염(잇몸염) · 치조(이틀)농루에 의한 여러 증상(잇몸의 발: This medicine is used to relieve the various symptoms caused by gingivitis (inflammation of the gums) and alveolar pyorrhoea (discharge of pus from the tooth sockets), namely redness (congested and reddened gums), swelling and pus of the gums, and bad breath.
entries.이 약은 항균 피부 세정제로서, 일반 피부 및 상처부위 세정, 수술시 손: This medicine is an antibacterial skin cleanser used for general cleansing of the skin and wounded areas, hand disinfection during surgery, personal hand disinfection, and disinfection of the skin at the surgical site before surgery.
entries.이 약을 사용하기 전에 의약품에 알레르기 경험자는 의사 또는 약사와 상의: Before using this medicine, anyone who has experienced an allergy to medicines should consult a doctor or pharmacist. When giving it to a child, administer it under the guidance and supervision of a guardian. Use it in the mouth only.
entries.이 약의 약액이 흡수된 스폰지를 손과 팔꿈치까지 적용하여 3분간 손으로: Apply the sponge soaked with the solution of this medicine to the hands and up to the elbows and rub by hand for 3 minutes. Rub the nails, the cuticles and the areas between the fingers with particular care. Use a brush to rub if necessary. Rinse with warm water, repeat the procedure washing for 3 minutes, rinse thoroughly with water and dry completely.
entries.일반 피부 및 상처부위 세정 시 세정할 부위를 물로 닦고, 피부나 상처에: For general cleansing of the skin and wounded areas, wet the area to be cleansed with water, take only the minimum amount needed for application to the skin or wound, apply it and then wipe it off gently. Then rinse thoroughly with water. For personal hand disinfection, wet the hands with water, apply 5 mL of this product to the hands and rub both hands vigorously for 15 seconds. Then rinse with water and dry completely.
entries.일시적으로 자극감, 발적 등이 나타나는 경우 사용을 즉각 중지하고 의사: If a temporary feeling of irritation or redness occurs, stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.장시간에 걸쳐 흡입하지 마십시오.눈에 액체 EO가스가 접촉하면 중도소의: Do not inhale it over a long period. If liquid EO gas contacts the eyes it may cause moderate damage. If EO gas is swallowed, the mucous membrane of the stomach and intestines is strongly irritated and burns may result.
Apply an appropriate amount to the application area in the evening and wash it off with water the next morning. Use it once every night until sweating stops, and reduce it to 1 to 2 times a week once the symptoms improve (get better).
entries.접촉피부염, 광과민증, 드물게 가려움, 발적, 피부 건조증상 등이 나타날: Contact dermatitis and photosensitivity may occur, and rarely itching, redness or dryness of the skin.
entries.치료 부위로부터 15~26cm 떨어진 거리에서 하루에 수 회 3~4시간: Spray from a distance of 15 to 26 cm from the area to be treated, several times a day every 3 to 4 hours. Spraying forms a thin powdery film, which may be covered with a bandage if necessary. Shake well before use.
entries.클로르헥시딘에 과민증 경험자, 2개월 이하의 영아는 이 약을 사용하지 마: Do not use this medicine in anyone who has experienced hypersensitivity to chlorhexidine or in infants aged 2 months or younger. Do not use it for disinfecting surgical instruments or on the brain, spinal cord, eyes, ears (inner, middle or outer ear) or mucous membranes (especially genital mucosa). Before using this medicine, consult a doctor or pharmacist if you have hypersensitivity to other medicines or an allergic constitution. Consult a doctor or pharmacist if it is to be used on broken skin (especially burns), on mucous membranes or on large areas of immature skin. Use it externally only; do not take it orally and do not inject it. Take care to keep it out of the eyes, and if it does get in, rinse them thoroughly with clean water immediately. Soaps weaken the bactericidal action of this medicine, so wash them off thoroughly before use. This medicine is adsorbed onto textiles and cloth (cotton, gauze, wool, rayon and the like), so when it is used by soaking such material, supply fresh solution whenever the effective concentration is no longer maintained. It is a flammable liquid, so handle it with care. Dry the treated area before using electrical equipment.
entries.피부에 닿았을 경우 즉시 오염된 의복 등을 벗고, 흐르는 물로 충분히 씻: If it comes into contact with the skin, immediately remove the contaminated clothing and wash the area thoroughly with running water. If it gets into the eyes, immediately rinse them with running water for at least 15 minutes and then consult a doctor. If the vapour is inhaled, move immediately to a place with fresh air and then consult a doctor. If it is swallowed by mistake, immediately have the person drink a large amount of water or milk, do not force vomiting, and consult a doctor. Clean thoroughly before disinfection to remove visible contaminants. Take sufficient care in storage and handling so that it is not drunk or swallowed by mistake. When disposing of the disinfectant solution, flush it away with a large amount of water.

If it comes into contact with the skin, immediately remove the contaminated clothing and wash the area thoroughly with running water. If pain continues, obtain treatment from a dermatologist. If it gets into the eyes, immediately rinse them with running water for at least 15 minutes and obtain examination by an ophthalmologist. Delayed or insufficient rinsing may cause damage to the eyes. If the vapour is inhaled, move immediately to a place with fresh air and consult a specialist. If it is swallowed by mistake, immediately have the person drink a large amount of water or milk, do not force vomiting, and obtain examination by a specialist. Forced vomiting may cause damage to the respiratory system. Handle it with sufficient care, for example by wearing protective equipment such as goggles, so that it never gets into the eyes. If it does get into the eyes, wash them with a large amount of water and then obtain treatment from a specialist.
